definition_english: An angular coordinate specifying the north-south position of a celestial object relative to an astronomical reference plane, such as the ecliptic (celestial or ecliptic latitude) or the galactic equator (galactic latitude).
definition_hindi: किसी खगोलीय संदर्भ तल, जैसे क्रांतिवृत्त (खगोलीय या क्रांतीय अक्षांश) अथवा मंदाकिनीय विषुवत् वृत्त (मंदाकिनीय या गांगेय अक्षांश) के सापेक्ष किसी खगोलीय पिंड की उत्तर या दक्षिण कोणीय स्थिति।

etymology.root: lātitūdō (breadth, width) from lātus (broad, wide; Old Latin stlātus), PIE *stele- (to spread)
etymology.semantic_development: Extended from classical geographical 'breadth' (north-south angular distance) to celestial and galactic coordinate systems in astronomy and space science.

hindi.declension: Invariable adjective + a-ending masculine head noun (अकारान्त पुल्लिंग)
hindi.adjective_agreement: Head noun अक्षांश governs masculine agreement; pre-modifiers खगोलीय, क्रांतीय, मंदाकिनीय, गांगेय are invariable

usage_restrictions: Must specify the astronomical reference plane (ecliptic via खगोलीय/क्रांतीय अक्षांश, or galactic via मंदाकिनीय/गांगेय अक्षांश) where ambiguity with terrestrial latitude exists; must never be conflated with declination (दिक्पात).

linguistic_analysis.compound_structure: Domain-specifying invariable tatsama adjectives (खगोलीय, क्रांतीय, मंदाकिनीय, गांगेय) modify the masculine head noun अक्षांश without gender inflection on the modifier.
linguistic_analysis.gender_agreement: All astronomical compounds headed by अक्षांश take masculine grammatical agreement in Hindi.

conceptual_analysis.core_concept: Angular distance measured north or south from an astronomical fundamental plane rather than Earth's geographic Equator.
conceptual_analysis.reference_plane_distinction: Celestial/ecliptic latitude is anchored to the ecliptic (क्रांतिवृत्त), whereas galactic latitude is anchored to the galactic equator.
conceptual_analysis.neighbor_boundaries: Strictly distinct from declination (दिक्पात), which is measured from the celestial equator, and from terrestrial geographic latitude (HAT-003-S1).

pairwise_comparison.semantic_overlap: Both denote angular distance north or south of the ecliptic (क्रांतिवृत्त) in positional astronomy.
pairwise_comparison.difference: खगोलीय अक्षांश renders 'celestial latitude' broadly, whereas क्रांतीय अक्षांश explicitly highlights the ecliptic (क्रांतिवृत्त) as the reference plane.
pairwise_comparison.interchangeability: Contextually interchangeable in ecliptic coordinate contexts, though क्रांतीय अक्षांश is more explicit when contrasting multiple celestial coordinate systems.

pairwise_comparison.semantic_overlap: Both translate 'galactic latitude' in astrophysics and space science.
pairwise_comparison.difference: Both are noted together in the chat summary for ISRO-CSTT usage; the choice of modifier is a lexical preference, and their derivation and relative usage are not verified.
pairwise_comparison.interchangeability: Functionally interchangeable for 'galactic latitude', though corpus preference between the two is not yet established.

pairwise_comparison.semantic_overlap: Both are north-south angular coordinates used to locate celestial bodies.
pairwise_comparison.difference: खगोलीय अक्षांश is measured from the ecliptic (क्रांतिवृत्त), whereas दिक्पात (declination) is measured from the celestial equator.
pairwise_comparison.interchangeability: Never interchangeable; substituting one for the other causes a coordinate-system error.
